evidence.reason: Current code loads the helper before validating switch argument shapes. The unit branch raises Refused when --runtime is missing, and the checkout branch later raises Refused when --sha or --tag is missing, instead of using parser.error. This makes an invalid switch invocation a refusal and can mask the argument error behind helper-load failures; the health interval check already shows the intended parser.error path. The smallest fix is to validate both switch forms after parsing and before _load_helper. This is ordinary CLI argument-handling correctness, not a new owner decision.
